name: Formant vocal chop lead
desc: Vowel-filtered sawtooth sings a chopped E minor hook over four cycles while diphone syllable chops answer at shifting speeds, panning on a slow sine. Octave-echo sparkle and 4-bar chop doubles at peak.

rate.doc: pattern rate multiplier, bare JS arg

code.full: stack(note("<[e4 ~ g4 ~] [~ b4 ~ a4] [g4 ~ e4 ~] [~ f#4 ~ d4]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>").attack(.01).decay(.18).sustain(.25).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.2).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.55, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.3).delay(.25), n("<0 3 7 12>").s("diphone").speed("<1 1.25 .75 1.5>").struct("[~ x] ~ [~ x] [x ~]").gain(${gain}*.55).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(32)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[e4 g4 b4 a4] [b4 a4 g4 e4] [g4 b4 e5 d5] [f#4 a4 d4 e4]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u>").attack(.005).decay(.15).sustain(.22).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.5, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.28).delay(.25).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.2)), n("0 3 7 12").s("diphone").speed("<1 1.25 1.5 <.75 2>>").struct("[~ x] [x ~] [~ x] [x x]").gain(${gain}*.6).pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(16)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).orbit(5).play()
